title: Sunday · the ice machine hall
logline: The motel's hallway at 2 AM as a landscape: the carpet's pattern, the numbered doors, the ice machine at the end lit like a shrine, the hum line. Era III's perspective on a corridor.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the motel corridor at 2 AM in one-point perspective: patterned carpet, numbered doors, and at the far end the ice machine lit blue-white. The hum line.

image.prompt: a motel corridor at 2 AM in precise one-point perspective with patterned carpet and numbered doors and an ice machine glowing blue-white at the far end, a flat line beneath, no words

panels.name: Hall

panels.composition: Tier 2: the ice machine, close: the scoop, the flap, the light. The hum line.

image.prompt: a motel ice machine close up with its scoop and flap and blue-white light, a flat line beneath, no words

panels.name: Machine

panels.composition: Tier 3: the corridor from the machine's end, back toward the office's glow. The hum line. Held.

image.prompt: a motel corridor seen from the ice machine's end toward a distant glowing office door, a flat line beneath, no words

panels.name: Back

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The corridor as a landscape. Era III's one-point perspective.
